title: [Henri, duc de Guise] to the duc de Mercœur, 16 April 1587, BnF fr. 15564 f. 78 (DECODE R4158; siblings R4155, R4167)

documents.shelfmark: BnF fr. 15564 f. 78 (DECODE R4158, images P2/P3/P5)

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the letter; Lasry 2022 published only the key and the f. 27 decipherment.

transcription.source: DECODE R4158 images (one page in three overlapping frames)
transcription.notes: 952 label tokens with nomenclator groups as one token; 998 signs counting group members singly (NOTES tally).

system.summary: Homophonic substitution with a small nomenclator, in cipher runs interleaved with clear text.
system.sibling_key: George Lasry's 2022 key for BnF fr. 15564 (cryptiana GL.htm), fits unchanged; extended by about 15 values.

prior_solution.where: Lasry 2022 solved the key (GL.htm) and published the f. 27 decipherment only, not f. 78

conditions.human_role: Project-level: set up Claude Code with Opus 5 and posed the catalogue entry. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: cryptiana GL.htm: Lasry solved ff. 27, 78, 119, 142 in 2022; key table and f. 27 decipherment published.
Downloaded DECODE images of R4155, R4158, R4167 and neighbouring records.
Used the f. 27 overlay to calibrate sign shapes against Lasry's key.
Labelled every sign of f. 78 in f78_labels.txt, one line per cipher run.
Beam search over each label's key values under the fr-1600-letters order-5 model (beam2.py).
Consistent-assignment anneal, one value per label (consist.py): collapsed homophones, worse than the beam.
Three sign-by-sign passes against native-resolution crops added about 15 sign and code values.
Tally: 983 of 998 cipher signs read as sense; 15 open (3 code groups, 12 signs).

outcome.method_basis: George Lasry's 2022 key for the Guise-Mercoeur cipher in BnF fr. 15564 (cryptiana GL.htm, which names f. 78 among the letters he solved) was applied to a new sign-by-sign transcription of f. 78 with a beam search, and extended by about 15 sign and code values.
outcome.fraction_read_source: f78_reading.txt pass-3 tally, counted sign by sign: 983 of 998 cipher signs (group members counted singly) read as sense; [?], [??] and open code groups counted unread
outcome.notes: Read with Lasry's key extended; three code groups and twelve signs open.
